☄️: “www Be together with you, www? … If you really want that, I can consider it… What do you think…?”🌸在說自己聖誕節時的瑪莉歐派對玩的很爛，可是她忘了在她旁邊的就是一隻寂寞狗狗！

“Is🌸coming over to eat later?”
